result:
I ran all 14 queries against their input files and they returned sensible results. I did not re-run K1–K4 after the final edits.

Some answers rest on assumptions:
- **K5, K11, K14:** I sort twice, first by the tie-breaker and then by the main key. This relies on `sort` being stable, which I assumed from the output and did not confirm in the docs.
- **K11:** qlang has no trim verb. I trim by splitting on spaces, dropping empty pieces and rejoining. Inner spaces survive, and the sample data has none.
- **K3:** the level counts came back with keys `INFO`, `WARN`, `ERROR` and `DEBUG`.

Results:
- K1: 5
- K2: `{alice: 150.5, bob: 125.25, carol: 210}`
- K4: `["eslint","express","jest","nodemon","zod"]`
- K5: `[3,31,12]`
- K6: 34.7
- K7: `["api:3000","db:5432","web:8080"]`
- K8: `["Lovelace, Ada","Hopper, Grace","Liskov, Barbara"]`
- K9: `["u1","u2","u3","u5"]`
- K10: `{eng: 113.67, ops: 72.5, hr: 62.75}`
- K11: `["api","js","node"]`
- K12: 103.32
- K13: false
- K14: `[{o2,5},{o4,5},{o8,5}]`

K1: `["Apple","banana","APPLE","Cherry","banana","date","Date","elderberry"] * lower | distinct | count`
K2: `filter ~(/status | eq "paid") | groupBy ~(/customer) * (* (/total | coalesce 0) | sum)`
K3: `lines * split " " | groupBy ~(/1) * count`
K4: `[/dependencies /devDependencies] | reduce {} ~(union) | filter ~(startsWith "^") | keys * keyword`
K5: `filter ~(/state | eq "open") * {:id /id :c (coalesce ~(/comments) 0)} | sort ~(/id) | sort ~(/c | mul -1) | take 3 * /id`
K6: `lines | drop 1 * split "," | filter ~(/2 | lower | eq "de") | filter ~(/1 | eq "" | ne true) * (/1 | parseJson) | div (sum) (count) | round 1`
K7: `:s (/services) | s | keys * (:k (keyword) | s | at k | {:n k :p (at :port) :e (at :enabled)}) | filter ~(/e | eq true) | filter ~(/p | type | eq ::number) | sort ~(/p) * (:pp (/p | print) | /n | append ":" | append pp)`
K8: `/results * {:d (coalesce ~(/email | split "@" | last | lower) ~("")) :l (coalesce ~(/user/name/last) ~(null)) :f (coalesce ~(/user/name/first) ~(""))} | filter ~(/d | eq "example.com") | filter ~(/l | ne null) * (:f2 (/f) | /l | append ", " | append f2)`
K9: `filter ~(coalesce ~(/user) ~(null) | ne null) | filter ~(/action | lower | eq "login") * (/user | lower) | distinct | sort`
K10: `filter ~(coalesce ~(/salary) ~(null) | ne null) | groupBy ~(/dept) * (* /salary | div (sum) (count) | round 2)`
K11: `* (coalesce ~(/tags) ~("") | split "," * (lower | split " " | filter ~(ne "") | join " ") | filter ~(ne "")) | flat | groupBy ~(keyword) * count | :g (union {}) | g | keys * (:k (keyword) | {:t k :c (g | at k)}) | sort ~(/t) | sort ~(/c | mul -1) | take 3 * /t`
K12: `lines | filter ~(startsWith "#" | ne true) | filter ~(ne "") * (split "|" | mul (/1 | parseJson) (/2 | parseJson)) | sum | round 2`
K13: `/services | filter ~(/env | lower | eq "prod") | every ~(coalesce ~(/replicas) 1 | gte 2)`
K14: `* {:id /id :n (coalesce ~(/items * /qty | sum) ~(0))} | filter ~(/n | gt 0) | sort ~(/id) | sort ~(/n | mul -1) | take 3 * {:id /id :itemCount /n}`
